subject: Evaluation sprint charter and success signals — next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@healthsync.com>; Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@healthsync.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation sprint — recap & proposed success signals

Thanks again for the demo and the thoughtful questions earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight charter so we can kick off the 8-week evaluation sprint without ambiguity. TL;DR: agreed success signals, owners, and a Friday cadence for short syncs.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + contextual search across patient-support transcripts (~25M tokens/month).
- Must-haves: sub-200ms generation latency for 1–2k token outputs under 99th pct, data stays in HealthSync VPC, and audit logging + retention for 90 days.
- Nice-to-have: embedding-based rerank and a small custom intent classifier.

Proposed success signals (please confirm / edit):
1) Functional: 90% of 50 golden prompts produce acceptable summaries per your rubric (we'll share the rubric).
2) Performance: 99th percentile latency <= 200ms on the hosted-dedicated variant during representative load (3 concurrent request streams).
3) Operational: KV-cache warmup reduces token cost by >=12% for repeat queries within session windows.
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and audit log access validated by your security reviewer.

High-level timeline (8 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, environment access, and baseline demo dataset ingestion. Owner: Laura (RWD) & Marta (HealthSync).
- Week 1–2: Model configuration & dedicated pool setup. Owner: Aditya (RWD).
- Week 3–5: Integration + synthetic + golden prompts evaluation. Owner: HealthSync PMs + RWD Eng.
- Week 6–7: Performance load tests and cost tuning. Owner: Rishi (RWD).
- Week 8: Acceptance review & decision.

Immediate next steps (please action by EOW):
- HealthSync: share access to a representative dataset + list of 50 golden prompts (Carlos/Marta).
- HealthSync procurement: send any standard PO/contract constraints to procurement@redwood.com.
- RWD: Aditya to provision a short-lived dedicated pool and share ingress details.
- RWD: Rishi to draft a cost/runbook note for the pilot.

Attachments sent: [Attachment: evaluation-rubric-v1.docx] (initial scoring matrix)
Related links: Mutual action plan folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xEvalSprint

Weekly cadence: 15-min check-in on Fridays at 10:00am PT (we'll keep these tight). If that doesn't work for your team, propose alternatives.

Thanks — excited to get moving.

—
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks for the clear write-up. This mirrors our notes well. A few adjustments from our side:

1) On functional: we want the 50 golden prompts to include 15 edge-case transcripts (short/noise) and 10 regulatory phrasing checks. We'll push that list by Wednesday.
2) On performance: 200ms at 99th pct is aggressive but reasonable if we prioritize a smaller context window for summarization. Can the evaluation include a config that compares 1) full-context 2) 1024-token window?
3) Compliance: I've attached our initial security questionnaire and SOC pointer doc — can your security team confirm which evidence Redwood can provide in-week 2?

[Attachment: healthsync-soc2-questions.xlsx]

Procurement note: We'll need a short form SOW and a stub PO to process the dedicated pool spend — looping in procurement.

We'll aim to provide dataset access (S3 read-only with a scrubbed subset) and the golden prompt set by Wed EOD. Friday 10am PT works for the weekly sync for now.

Appreciate the rubric — we'll review and give line edits.

Best,
Marta
Director of Product, HealthSync
